name: Michalina Prusimska

events.note: The Governing Commission at Dresden returned to her the goods confiscated from her father.

Named with her husband as lords of Trąbczyn in the judgment of 1827; "Michalina Miączyńska, owner of Trąbczyn" in 1846. Żychliński (p. 221) has Stanisław pass the Trąbczyn estate to his son Mieczysław in 1845; the documents are taken.

citations.page: 4.285.278, 4.285.273; Akt małżeństwa Warszawa ASC Cyrkuł IV, 67/1810

events.note: Civil marriage at Warsaw (ASC Cyrkuł IV, act 67, 17 August 1810), church wedding at St Andrew's on 21 August 1810. Żychliński (p. 221) and the PSB have August 1809: a year too early; the month is right. Their son Aleksander was born on 9 January 1810, before the wedding.

notes: Called Michalina Prusimska in a letter of January 1802, "Dąmbska" in the petitions of July 1807.
